metadata.name: ntfy-server-deployment
metadata.summary: Deploy a private ntfy server on a Gentoo/OpenRC host and validate local health.

variables.name: repo_root
variables.description: Absolute path to the repository root.

variables.name: inventory_path
variables.description: Inventory file containing the ntfy_servers host group.

variables.name: limit_host
variables.description: Host or group limit for the ntfy server deployment.

stages.summary: Validate the ntfy server playbook and inventory wiring.
notes: Run this before touching a live ntfy server host.

stages.summary: Apply the ntfy server role to the destination host.
notes: The binary install path downloads the upstream release tarball and installs /usr/local/bin/ntfy.
The role assumes an OpenRC-managed destination host.

stages.summary: Confirm the ntfy daemon is up and answering health checks.
notes: If the service is behind a reverse proxy, validate the proxied base URL instead.
